Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

Then prove both directions, review, merge, publish, re-install. Successor to ledger-v2-archive-and-seed.

open_risks: The STATUS QUO IS SAFER. Live install is 0fe1c02 - it over-blocks reads but resists evasion. There is no urgency to ship. Merging fix/pre-tool-use-guard as-is would NET-WEAKEN the store: 20 commands the old guard DENIED are ALLOWED by it, 12/12 reproduced. See predecessor decision 0011.

Root cause is architectural: the guard is allow-unless-provably-destructive over a hand-rolled bash parser, so every parse gap is a silent evasion. Fix by inverting to deny-by-default within the root, never by enumerating gaps.

Branch tip is 5f04dd4 (resolve quoted paths), one commit PAST the b0e1079 that predecessor decisions 0008 and 0011 evaluated. Re-verify which commit the 12 evasions were reproduced against before trusting either finding.
scanSegments is quadratic in tokens per segment (128k tokens = 15.2s) against a 10s hook timeout, so the guard fails OPEN under a large single-line command. Any size cap added must fail CLOSED.

REFUTED, do not re-litigate: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA IS delivered to hooks and the real store IS protected today. ledger-roots.mjs is byte-identical across 0fe1c02 and b0e1079. The old probe measured the env-absent fallback. See predecessor decision 0007.

Guard work lives in /Users/satanshumishra/Documents/DevLabs/continuity-ledger-plugin - a DIFFERENT repo from .windful-ocean. Working tree clean, on fix/pre-tool-use-guard. Do not look for hooks/ in the windful-ocean repo.

The v2 store is git-ref-backed at refs/heads/_ledger, not a working directory. Read thread state with `git show refs/heads/_ledger:threads/<id>.json`. An ls of <repo>/.git/ledger shows an empty dir and looks like data loss - it is not.
Concurrent sessions write ONE store. Decision numbers are not contiguous and you may not hold the latest state. Never assume.
Spine list items are capped at 300 chars each; an over-cap item rejects the WHOLE update_thread call rather than truncating. Completion criteria are immutable after creation.
